Filmetrics® F54-XY-200 and F54-XY-300 Film Thickness Measurement Mapping Instruments
Filmetrics® F54-XY-200 and F54-XY-300 Film Thickness Measurement Mapping Instruments
The F54-XY Series of automated benchtop mapping systems measure film thickness, refractive index, reflectance, absorption, and surface roughness for patterned samples up to 300mm in diameter. Five configurations cover film thickness from 4nm up to 120µm, with spot size from 2µm to 100µm.
 Download BrochureContact Us for a Quote(858) 573-9300
 Product DetailsModel SpecificationsIndustriesAccessoriesTechnical LiteratureRelated Products 
 Product Details
 Model Specifications
 Industries
 Accessories
 Technical Literature
 Related Products
Product Description 
The Filmetrics F54-XY-200 and F54-XY-300 automated thin-film thickness mappers measure patterned and unpatterned samples up to 200mm and 300mm diameter, respectively. Samples are easily mapped with an advanced spectral reflectance system and industry leading Filmetrics algorithms. 
The compact system brings precision measurement positioning to production applications. The motorized XY-200 stage moves automatically to specified measurement locations, providing results as quick as two points per second. Measurements of 300mm wafers are supported by the additional high performance rotary stage in the F54-XYT-300 configuration. 
Product Features 
Supports measurement of both patterned and unpatterned samples 
Wavelength range configurations cover 190 – 1700nm 
Minimum spot size of 5μm 
Autofocus and Pattern Recognition ability 
Enclosure interlock 
Live video image 
Accommodates up to 300mm round samples 
User-specified sample point mapping using rectangular, linear, polar, and custom configurations 
Manual or automatic deskew 
Sophisticated history function for saving, reproducing and plotting results 
On-board reflectance and thickness standards 
Comprehensive material library and advanced modeling algorithms 
24-hour/5-day phone, email and online support 
Applications 
Microspot measurement for patterned and unpatterned surfaces 
Industries 
Semiconductor process films 
Compound semiconductor films 
Liquid crystal displays (LCDs) 
Optical coatings and electro-optical films 
Biomedical films and medical devices 
MEMS 
Look at the Industries tab for additional details. 
Choose the right Filmetrics F54-XY configuration for your measurements 
F54-XY configurations are distinguished primarily by the thickness measurement range, which in turn is determined by the instrument’s wavelength range. Shorter wavelengths (F54-XY-200-UV) are required for measurement of thinner films, while longer wavelengths are required for measurement of rougher, thicker, and more opaque films.

Semiconductor Process Films 
Measure thickness of various process films, including polysilicon, photoresist, oxides, nitrides, and silicon-on-insulator (SOI). Thinned silicon can also be measured. Our extensive library of refractive indices addresses a wide array of processing conditions. 
Compound Semiconductor Films 
Measure both film thickness and optical properties of compound semiconductor materials, films or wafers, including GaN and SiC, using our non-destructive optical characterization method. 
Liquid Crystal Displays (LCDs) 
Measure cell gaps and thickness of polyimides, indium tin oxide (ITO) and transparent conductive oxide (TCO) films. The comprehensive Filmetrics material library and advanced modeling algorithms deliver the advanced capabilities needed for measuring LCD and OLED layers. 
Optical Coatings and Electro-optical Films 
Measure the thickness of hardcoats, anti-reflective coatings and filters. With spectral reflectance and Filmetrics advanced modeling algorithms, you can model more than 10 layers effectively. 
Biomedical Films and Medical Devices 
Measure the thickness and uniformity of parylene and other protective coatings for implanted devices. Precise stage positioning on the F54-XY allows for automated measurement of device arrays fixtured to the stage, and the wide wavelength range allows for measurement of thicker films. 
MEMS 
Measure thickness of photoresist, silicon membranes and dielectric stacks. Target critical parts and map thickness uniformity to discover and address flaws early in the manufacturing process. 
Listed below are the most frequently purchased accessories for this product. To peruse or talk to our experts about our full list of available accessories, or to shop directly from our webstore, please visit our Accessories page here. 
NIST-traceable Film Thickness Standards 
KLA Instruments offers a wide selection of thin-film thickness standards for calibrating and verifying the accuracy of thin-film measurement systems. Filmetrics thin-film thickness standards meet the highest industry standards and can be supplied as NIST-traceable. If you don’t see the thickness standard you need for your film thickness measurements, please contact us. Our team of experts will work with you to provide the right thin-film thickness standard solution for your needs. 
Silicon Wafer Backside Failure Analysis
 Electronic device failure analysis (EDFA) is used for wafer backside thinning, where the thinned silicon substrate is transmissive at near-infrared (NIR) wavelengths. The F20-NIR can measure thinned silicon, and the F3-sX can measure thick layers, up to 1.5mm. 
 Download PDF
Measuring Film Thickness of ITO and Other Display Materials
 Liquid crystal displays (LCDs) and OLEDs rely on transparent conductive oxides (TCOs) to transport current, and it is important to now the thickness of the layers that form the display. For LCDs, the F-series systems can measure the polyimide and LC layers, while for OLEDs, they measure the emitting, injecting and encapsulation layers. 
 Download PDF
MEMS: Thickness of Silicon and Process Films
 Liquid crystal displays (LCDs) and OLEDs rely on transparent conductive oxides (TCOs) to transport current, and it is important to know the thickness of the layers that form the display. For LCDs, the F-series systems can measure the polyimide and LC layers, while for OLEDs, they measure the emitting, injecting and encapsulation layers. 
 Download PDF
Measuring SU-8 Photoresist Thickness
 Though simple and quick, spin coating SU-8 can be an inaccurate method for yielding a desired thickness. Since exposure time is dependent on resist thickness, and since positive and negative photoresists can be used in conjunction to create complex multilayer structures, accurate measurement of the thickness of each layer becomes extremely important. 
 Download PDF
Porous Semiconductors
 Porous semiconductors (PS) are used in applications ranging from optical devices to gas sensors, and properties impacting PS performance include layer thickness and porosity, either in single or periodic multilayers. Other important properties relate to processed PS layers, such as the fraction of impregnated materials and the amount of adsorbed molecules in sensing devices. 
 Download PDF
Wafer Thickness Measurement
 Silicon wafer thickness can be easily and quickly measured using Filmetrics® spectral reflectometers with high resolution near-infrared (NIR) spectrometers. The Filmetrics F3-sX system family uses NIR light to measure layer thickness, even many layers that are visibly opaque, such as semiconductors. 
 Download PDF
Measuring OLED Layers
 A typical OLED structure includes multiple specialized layers: Hole Injection Layers, Hole Transport Layers and Recombination/ Emission layers. All these layers contain optically complex organic molecules. OLED properties also enable flexible displays, which may require measurement on highly birefringent substrates such as PET. The Filmetrics® F20-UV and F40-UV instruments offer inexpensive, robust and non-invasive metrology for simple prototype devices to fully pixelated displays. 
 Download PDF
Ophthalmic Coatings
 Coatings continue to play a critical role in eyeglass performance, appearance and durability. The Filmetrics F10-AR is the first instrument designed for simple, affordable testing of ophthalmic anti-reflection (AR) coatings and hardcoats, enabling line operators to make conclusive readings in seconds and with only minutes of training. 
 Download PDF
Parylene Coatings
 The Filmetrics® F20, F40 and F3-CS Thin-Film Analyzers are used for thickness and uniformity measurement of parylene coatings, which are widely used in the biomedical industry due to their unique properties. 
 Download PDF
Medical Device Coating Thickness
 The Filmetrics® F20 and F40 Thin-Film Analyzers use spectral reflectance technology for layer thickness measurement of different types of coatings used on medical devices. This discussion includes thickness measurement of a pharmacological coating on a medical stent, thickness of a polymer wire coating, and angioplasty balloon wall thickness. 
 Download PDF
How Many Layers Can You Measure?
 The Filmetrics® F10-RT-UVX was used to measure a multilayer dielectric stack of unknown materials, resolving not only the number of layers and the index of refraction of the high index material, but the thickness of each individual layer. 
 Download PDF
Large Area Characterization of Graphene using Spectroscopic Reflectometry
 The Filmetrics® F10-RT Thin-Film Analyzer was used to measure the index of refraction of graphene, using the simultaneous capture of reflectance and transmittance spectra. The F50 thin film mapping tool was used to measure and map graphene monolayer and bilayer uniformity across an entire wafer. 
 Download PDF
Filmetrics® F40 Film Thickness Measurement Instrument
Attaches to your microscope to measure thickness and index in spots as small as 1µm in patterned, curved, and non-uniform samples.
 Product Details
Filmetrics® F50 Automated Film Thickness Mapper
Adds automated mapping capabilities to our F20 family of products. Map thickness and index as fast as two points per second.
 Product Details
Filmetrics® F54 Film Thickness Measurement Mapping Instrument
Maps thin-film thickness of samples up to 450mm in diameter as fast as two points per second.
